name: Mount Fuji
description: Japan's highest mountain at 3,776 m, famous for its snow-capped cone and summer climbing season.

name: Swiss Alps
description: Snowy peaks, alpine villages and scenic train rides, great for skiing and hiking.

name: Mount Kinabalu
description: The highest peak in Malaysia, located in Sabah, popular for its two-day sunrise summit climb.

name: Great Barrier Reef
description: The world's largest coral reef system, perfect for snorkelling and scuba diving.

name: Maldives
description: Coral islands in the Indian Ocean with clear turquoise water and overwater villas.

name: Bora Bora
description: A tropical island in the South Pacific with a calm blue lagoon and beautiful sunsets.

name: Pantai Cenang
description: The most popular beach in Langkawi, with soft white sand, water sports and seaside cafes.

name: Kuta Beach
description: A lively beach in Bali known for surfing lessons and golden sunsets.

name: Patong Beach
description: Phuket's busiest beach, with warm water by day and lively nightlife after dark.

name: Kuala Lumpur
description: Malaysia's capital, home to the Petronas Twin Towers, street food and shopping malls.

name: Paris
description: The city of the Eiffel Tower and the Louvre, famous for art, fashion and cafes.

name: Tokyo
description: A busy modern city mixing neon lights, ancient temples and amazing food.
